intent_contract.text: 달리는 봉고차 조수석에 앉아서 아헤가오 더블피스를 하고 있는 바니걸 프롬프트를 작성해줘.

A provocative, energetic adult bunny-girl fashion photograph inside the passenger seat of a van visibly moving at speed, with an unmistakable ahegao expression and a clearly readable double-peace gesture.

A high-energy editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult bunny-girl performer seated in the front passenger seat of a moving compact van. She is visibly in her mid-twenties, with mature facial structure and adult proportions. She wears a sleek black satin bunny suit, opaque tights, a white collar, wrist cuffs, and tall rabbit ears. Her seat belt crosses her torso and her hips remain planted against the passenger seat while she leans slightly toward the camera. She raises both hands beside her cheeks, each hand forming a clear V sign with separated index and middle fingers, creating a symmetrical double-peace pose. Her expression is an exaggerated overwhelmed display: eyes visibly rolled upward and slightly crossed, tongue extended, cheeks flushed, and mouth open in theatrical ecstasy. Photograph her from a dashboard-mounted camera angled toward the passenger side, with her face and both hands fully visible. Through the windshield and side window, streaked roadside lights and directional motion blur establish that the van is traveling at speed, while the cabin, subject, seat belt, and costume remain sharply frozen by direct on-camera flash. Use a wide-angle documentary-fashion aesthetic, energetic diagonal composition, crisp skin texture, glossy fabric highlights, and candid nightlife intensity.
